convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load 'CHOWithFlat' custom indicator with multiple non-standard parameters. Includes external .mqh library (TradeAlgorithms.mqh) for trade execution logic. Custom smoothing methods beyond built-in MT5 options.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator calculation
TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds
derived_values.used_by: Signal time calculation for position open gating

other_exits: Opposite signal closes existing position: when Up>Dn crossover, closes sell; when Up<Dn crossover, closes buy

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MM input: negative=fixed lots, positive=fraction of margin. MMMode selects between LOT, FREEMARGIN, and LOT_MARGIN modes from TradeAlgorithms.mqh

custom_logic_notes: The CHOWithFlat indicator is a Chaikin Oscillator with flat zone filtering via Bollinger Bands. It uses 2 buffers: Up (buffer 0) and Dn (buffer 1). Entry uses SignalBar=1 (previous completed bar) comparing bar[1] vs bar[2] values (Up[1] vs Dn[1] for current state, Up[0] vs Dn[0] for previous state to detect crossover). The GlobalVariableDel_ call in OnDeinit cleans up global variables used by TradeAlgorithms.mqh for position tracking. Signal time is set to last bar date + TimeShiftSec for trade gating. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose input booleans can independently disable each direction's entry and exit.
python_conversion_notes: The CHOWithFlat custom indicator must be reimplemented in Python. It combines Chaikin Oscillator (fast/slow MA of Accumulation/Distribution) with Bollinger Band flat-zone filtering. The 10 smoothing methods (SMA, EMA, SMMA, LWMA, JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA) in the Smooth_Method enum require implementation, particularly JJMA, JurX, ParMA which are non-standard. TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, LoadHistory, CIsNewBar) must be reimplemented. The position sizing logic with MMMode enum (LOT/FREEMARGIN/LOT_MARGIN) needs careful translation. Signal logic reads buffer values at SignalBar offset (bar[1] and bar[2] relative to current) - must replicate this indexing correctly in Python.
